advancements.cortescombat.arcabuz: A bamboo, a firer, a dispenser and some wood. The Firestone is the expensive part.
enchantment.cortescombat.adrenalina.desc: Pain makes you quicker; the second time, stronger.
enchantment.cortescombat.apunalar.desc: What doesn't see it coming hurts twice as much.
enchantment.cortescombat.astilladora.des: Blocking against this edge costs double.
enchantment.cortescombat.audacity.desc: Every body you pass through gives your breath back.
enchantment.cortescombat.aventurero.desc: The fallen leave experience to spare.
enchantment.cortescombat.barredor.desc: The arm sweeps more than it seems.
enchantment.cortescombat.capacitor.desc: What they fire at you returns with interest.
enchantment.cortescombat.culata.desc: The bayonet doesn't shove: it sweeps.
The charged hit doesn't kill: it leaves you open.
enchantment.cortescombat.desvio_vampiric: Each parry makes you a little greater.
enchantment.cortescombat.dry_powder.desc: The second loading waits less than the first.
enchantment.cortescombat.ensarte.desc: The thrust does not stop at the first.
enchantment.cortescombat.estocada.desc: What the lunge pierces does not hide behind armour.
The hand weighs less; the swing, slower.
Foreign armour weighs against its owner.
enchantment.cortescombat.gold_echo.desc: Your mark is an invitation everyone answers.
enchantment.cortescombat.golden_hands.de: What the shovel touches is already yours.
What is cut returns to the earth; sometimes twice.
enchantment.cortescombat.gripa.desc: Every hit leaves the target snifflier.
enchantment.cortescombat.guardia_firme.d: The first stand of every while is free.
enchantment.cortescombat.inercia.desc: The streak doesn't shove: it lifts.
enchantment.cortescombat.life_steal.desc: What you take from others, you keep a little.
enchantment.cortescombat.mella.desc: Their armour wears faster than yours.
enchantment.cortescombat.midas_tool.desc: The mine delivers its treasure bathed in gold.
enchantment.cortescombat.midas_touch.des: The fallen leave copper; sometimes more.
enchantment.cortescombat.miner_frenzy.de: The stone yields faster than it should.
enchantment.cortescombat.mungus.desc: Ten Firestones for one shot that opens the mountain.
enchantment.cortescombat.pala_antimateri: An orb that calls its own and spares none.
enchantment.cortescombat.paliza.desc: Closing a streak has its reward.
enchantment.cortescombat.phantom_block.d: Sometimes the block decides to give twice.
Enemy armour counts for less than it says.
enchantment.cortescombat.punta_fina.desc: The closer they are, the deeper it bites.
enchantment.cortescombat.quebranto.desc: Each hit peels a little of his shell.
enchantment.cortescombat.retirada.desc: Sneak, and the lunge does the unexpected.
enchantment.cortescombat.rey_de_las_mosc: The shot doesn't end where it lands.
The chain stretches while the rhythm holds.
enchantment.cortescombat.riposte.desc: What comes back after you cover weighs less.
enchantment.cortescombat.sanguijuela.des: Their blood ends up in your veins.
enchantment.cortescombat.santa_muerte.de: What kills lingers a while longer.
A sweep that killed nobody gives your arm back.
enchantment.cortescombat.segundo_aliento: When your guard falls, your arm quickens.
enchantment.cortescombat.sentencia.desc: Five streak hits and the body gives out.
enchantment.cortescombat.steel_reflex.de: A steel that learns from every blow it turns aside.
enchantment.cortescombat.trabazon.desc: A charged hit takes your legs from you.
enchantment.cortescombat.wind_walker.des: The wind carries you; the higher, the further.
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.arcabuz: Spends a Firestone from the inventory: right click reloads, left click fires
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.halberd: Right click: sweeps the whole arc, and costs the same cooldown as a hit
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.mace: The damage is the fall: up to %s, falling %s blocks. Landing a hit cancels the fall
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.ropera: Right click: forward lunge, and it passes through several
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.sabre: Right click: parry. A %s s window, a %s s cooldown
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.trident: Right click throws it; charged, it pulls the target in
tooltip.cortescombat.mechanic.warhammer: Escalates with each consecutive hit; the streak lasts %s s
tooltip.cortescombat.special.fusee: Right Click: spends a Firestone, and a second later burns the whole cone
tooltip.cortescombat.special.multi_hit: Right Click: hits everything in the cone
tooltip.cortescombat.special.parry: Right Click: parry, returns the hit you take
